1368.0.0.description:
Log TestSuite PostRun failure for results publishing

Test-harness step (not a functional test): logs the test-suite post-run outcome for results publishing. Excluded from manual-test coverage mapping.

1368.1001.0.description:
Log TestSet setup outcome

Test-harness step (not a functional test): logs the per-test-set setup outcome before the set's functional cases run. Excluded from manual-test coverage mapping.

1368.1001.1.description:
Configure MRU on a port interface and MTU on L3 interface and verify same with show commands

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies the configuration and reporting of L2 MRU and L3 MTU. Sets a maximum receive unit on a switchport and a larger MTU on a VLAN/L3 interface, then confirms the show interface output reflects the configured MRU and MTU values. Restores the test-set configuration on teardown and confirms no exceptions occur.

1368.1001.2.description:
Send 9000 byte packet (with DF flag set) without L3 Jumbo frames enabled and verify the packet is dropped

[Log-derived analysis] Confirms the default behavior when L3 jumbo frames are not enabled. Routes traffic through the DUT and first checks that a small sub-MTU packet is correctly L3-switched out the egress interface, then sends a jumbo-sized packet with the DF flag set and verifies the DUT drops it rather than forwarding an oversized frame. Restores configuration and checks for no exceptions.

1368.1001.3.description:
Send 9000 byte packet with L3 Jumbo frames enabled and verify the packet is correctly L3 switched

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that enabling L3 jumbo frames allows oversized packets to be routed. With jumbo frames disabled it first confirms a jumbo-sized packet is dropped, then enables L3 jumbo frames on the ingress and egress VLANs and confirms the same jumbo-sized packet is now correctly L3-switched out the egress interface. Restores configuration and checks for no exceptions.

1368.1001.4.description:
Send 9000 byte packet with L3 Jumbo frames enabled on ingress vlan and disabled on egress vlan, verify packet is dropped

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that L3 jumbo frames must be enabled on both the ingress and egress L3 interfaces. With jumbo frames enabled only on the ingress VLAN it confirms the jumbo packet is dropped, then enables jumbo frames on both VLANs and confirms the jumbo packet is correctly L3-switched through. Restores configuration and checks for no exceptions.

1368.1001.5.description:
Send 10000 byte packet with MTU set to 9200 and verify the packet is fragmented by DUT

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies DUT fragmentation of packets larger than the configured MTU. With jumbo frames enabled and an MTU set, it confirms a jumbo packet within the MTU is switched, then sends a packet larger than the MTU and verifies the DUT fragments it on egress. Restores configuration and checks for no exceptions.

1368.1001.6.description:
Send 1600 byte packet with MTU set to default and verify the packet is fragmented by DUT

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies DUT fragmentation at the default MTU. With the L3 interface MTU left at its default, it routes a packet larger than the default MTU through the DUT and confirms the DUT fragments it on egress. Restores configuration and checks for no exceptions.

1368.1001.7.description:
Configure static ip route and send 9000 byte packet via the static route and verify it is dropped by DUT when MTU is set to default

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies jumbo-frame handling over a static IP route at default MTU. Configures a static route on the DUT and confirms a small packet is correctly L3-switched out via that route, then sends a jumbo-sized packet and verifies the DUT drops it because jumbo frames are not enabled at the default MTU. Restores configuration and checks for no exceptions.

1368.1001.8.description:
Configure static ip route and send 9000 byte packet with L3 Jumbo frame enabled and verify it is switched by DUT honoring the static route

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies jumbo-frame forwarding over a static IP route. With L3 jumbo frames enabled and a static route configured on the DUT, it sends a jumbo-sized packet and verifies the DUT correctly L3-switches it out the egress interface dictated by the static route. Restores configuration and checks for no exceptions.
